aemilia_frontage.source_figure: Samuel Ball Platner 1904, fig.24; edited scan credited Saikindi on Commons
aemilia_frontage.method: Least-squares affine, source pixel centres hand-read; east/north metres relative to Aemilia OSM centre. Control centres include already registered schematic landmark centres, not survey benchmarks.
aemilia_frontage.uncertainty: Approximate plan alignment. Max control residual5.11m; allow about5m or more at unobserved corners. Historical map is not an Augustan phase survey.
aemilia_frontage.finding: Forum-facing line local x varies -34.52 to -27.71m, beside proposal x=-30.1m. This supports southwest frontage position only; 8m shop depth/8m walk and16 equal bays remain estimates.
aemilia_frontage.native_extent_note: 27m is main-hall total width including aisles. long_hall does not add aisle widths. Parts extent is symmetric about origin;61.4m current symmetric extent is not the approximately44.8m occupied width including roof. Earlier68.2m extent included the removed deck.

augustus_forum.registration_limit: Temple platform centre picked at500,113px and tied to retained OSM Mars landmark point. Existing -51degree axis agrees with plan north arrow. Point registration is approximate, allow about5m; this is not a new multi-point geodetic survey.
augustus_forum.source_warning: Official figure explicitly labels minor exedrae hypothetical. Official prose rounds whole enclosure120x120m, court70x50m and all exedrae diameter40m; figure distinguishes smaller western pair. Native elliptical idealisations follow figure proportions, not an assertion of exact excavated circular diameters.

pantheon.phase_limit: OSM is only modern site/axis control. DAR reports early foundations under north portico and an early circular wall of same curvature. Exterior modern diameter is a spatial envelope, not an excavated Augustan ambulatory width.
pantheon.native_choice: Conditional open-court/parapet interpretation attributed by DAR toTortorici.0.61m wall thickness and1.65m preserved height come from reported early wall fragment;1.65m is used only as a low boundary proxy,not an assertion of full original AD14 height. Exterior circle follows modern curvature control. Roofed-circle and covered-ambulatory hypotheses unresolved.
